game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail, the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre: the fire warden must handle magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Ash Rim Trail open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ash Rim Trail: the crumbling rim of Mt. Pyre
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read n. Display Above when n > -2; otherwise display At or below. Test dataset 3: {'n': -4}; {'n': 1}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Ash Rim Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the magma valve using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The magma valve reached with actions_used <= 20.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the magma valve is reached, or lives reach 0.
source_game_title: Modulo Gate – Ash Rim Trail Trial
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
